learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn fun words that tell us what people, animals, and things do!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Action words show us doing something. When you jump or run, you are doing an action! They are also called doing words.
Can you clap your hands? Clap is an action word! Any word that makes your body move is a doing word.

fun_activity.title: 🕺 Action Time Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your mummy or papa to say an action word out loud. You have to do that action very quickly!

quick_recap: ⭐ Action words tell us what we are doing right now.
⭐ Words like play, eat, sit, and read are all action words.
